summary: Meet Emma, a young fashionista and start your shop management journey
description:
Take your fashion skills to a new level in Emma’s Journey: Fashion Shop, our free and addictive time management game. Let Emma become your favorite fashionista, work hard together and earn rewards for a job well done!

The engaging game story will make you wanna know what's next and the levels will require time management skills and a fast pace. Pay attention to the clients' requests, find the items in the shop, combine and deliver them in the shortest time. Be quick, or the clients will get angry and leave. Improve the shops with better quality tools or choose new abilities for Emma.

Our fashion themed time management game will entertain you with unique fashion shops and challenging levels. Complete all of them and discover the story behind!

Emma’s Journey Fashion Shop features:
- Awesome game characters
- Fun levels with special tasks and hidden stickers
- Realistic selling experience
- A wide variety of stylish fashion items to sell
- Different shops and special upgrades
- An amazing time management experience for all ages

Choose what you’re going to sell in each fashion shop, discover all the shops and keep up with Emma’s personal life and job. 

Download now and discover your new favorite time management game! Emma’s Journey: Fashion Shop is a totally free game, fun and easy to play!
